Visible text:
Hydraulic power: symbol key

P = ρ g H Q

ρ = fluid density

g = gravitational acceleration

H = head (vertical height difference)

Q = volume flow rate

Visual structure:
A plain white slide with dark gray text aligned along the left. The large title is at the upper left. Below it, the equation appears on its own line, followed by four widely spaced symbol definitions in a vertical list. No diagrams, arrows, axes, or tables are present.
